spec: Implement the user-supplied requirements at https://github.com/contoso/ledger-service/issues/45. Source revision: 2026-09-07T08:30:00Z. Task acceptance criteria below map that scope to specialist-owned work.

tasks.title: Move the build to Flyway 10
tasks.body:
Set the Flyway version to 10 in the root `pom.xml`, manage `flyway-database-postgresql` with the same version, and add it to `ledger-persistence/pom.xml`.

## Acceptance criteria
- `mvn -B -ntp verify` passes on JDK 21.
- The PostgreSQL driver version is unchanged.
- No migration file changes.

tasks.title: Adapt the migrator to Flyway 10
tasks.body:
Update `FlywayMigrator` and the `ledger-persistence` integration tests to the Flyway 10 API and defaults.

## Acceptance criteria
- `JdbcLedgerRepositoryIT` passes against PostgreSQL in Testcontainers.
- Production code never enables `clean`.
- Migrations still run at application start.

tasks.title: Validate a Flyway 7 schema history
tasks.body:
Add an integration test that starts from a database whose `flyway_schema_history` was written by Flyway 7 and runs the Flyway 10 migrator against it.

## Acceptance criteria
- `validate` passes and no migration is applied again.
- The fixture is a captured history, not a hand-written guess.
